title: Proposition 2.11: resolution of a T-structure by elementary objects under a p-colimit
statement_scope: Let T be a pregeometry, X an infinity-topos, p: Str^loc_T(X) -> X the Cartesian fibration, q: E -> X a Cartesian fibration, and Q: E^> -> Str^loc_T(X) a functor. Suppose: (i) p o Q extends q and carries the cone point of E^> to the final object 1 of X; (ii) for each e in E, Q(e) is an elementary object of Str^loc_T(X); (iii) for each X in X the fiber E_X is essentially small and sifted; (iv) Q carries q-Cartesian morphisms to p-Cartesian morphisms; (v) Q exhibits Str^loc_T(X) as a p-colimit of q; (vi) the cone point maps to an object whose underlying X-object is 1. Then Q is a p-colimit diagram resolving the given T-structure by elementary objects.
